04
EVERYDAY EXPERIENCE

Know what is happening. Stay in control.

A clearer workspace, from your first launch to your next creation.

Activity in sight

Track server startup, generations, downloads, workflow activity and roleplay away mode in the activity bar.

A calmer interface

Consistent headings and icons, compact media actions, clearer music controls and an easier language selector.

Local first

Local inference remains free. Models download when needed. Wallets are optional for core creation; outside services are explicit.

Before you start
Models are downloaded separately and performance depends on your device. Company automation uses a workspace license; personal local inference remains free. Connected tools require authorization. Onchain features require configured deployments. This is the v4 release preview; platform installers are validated separately.
